data.name: xrLabel7.Text
data.value: The material should be packed as per international packing standards which should be enough to bear high temperatures and weather conditions without invulnerabilities during voyage and storage such as rain humidity, dust storms and temperature variations.

data.name: xrLabel2.Text
data.value: • Original Signed & Stamped Commercial invoice with origin and HS code. • ORIGINAL Signed I Stamped Packing list (with complete actual dimensions, Weight & No of boxes) • Signed & Stamped Certificate of compliance on letterhead. • Photographs of the material before and after packing with clear Part number. • Rejection of material due to mismatch of specifications quoted /specified. due to supply of used/ refurbished • Material. supplier shall be responsible to either replace these Items free of cost or refund the amount paid by us including freight. taxes and duties Paid at destination port. • Material should be brand new and in accordance to our specifications. • Warranty certificate
